newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: BANGLADESH TAKA ENDS STEADY, RECOVERS EARLY LOSS.
newsitem.headline: BANGLADESH TAKA ENDS STEADY, RECOVERS EARLY LOSS.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka finished little changed on Thursday, erasing early losses on rising call rates and selling of U.S. dollars.
Dealers said the taka ended at Wednesday's closing level of 44.2000 per dollar against an open at 44.1980/2080.
They said a sharp hike in call rates and steady dollar selling by leading state-owned and foreign banks helped the taka sustain the previous session's level.
Call money was traded at 8.5 to 9.5 percent against the previous close at 4.5-6.5 percent. Call rates rose due to Wednesday's auction of central bank bills worth about 4.7 billion taka.
